title: Complete Java, Spring, and Microservices course
notes: Comprehensive masterclass covering Core Java, JUnit, DSA, Git, JDBC, Servlets & JSP, Hibernate, REST APIs, Spring Framework, Spring Boot, MongoDB, and Microservices.

mustWatch.note: Core for Spring Bean & Repository Architecture
Essential Data Structures in Enterprise Backends

studyGuide.prerequisiteChain: Java Fundamentals → OOP → JDBC → Hibernate → Spring Core → Spring Boot → REST API → Microservices

springBootRelevance.OOP & Classes: Basis for Spring Beans, Components, Services, and Controllers.
springBootRelevance.Interfaces: Used for Repository layers in Spring Data JPA and dependency abstraction.
springBootRelevance.Exceptions: Central to global error handling in Spring Boot (@ControllerAdvice / @ExceptionHandler).
springBootRelevance.JDBC / Hibernate: Foundation for Spring Data JPA and entity persistence.

canWatchQuickly.reason: If already familiar with standard Git CLI version control.
Only needed for historical context; Spring MVC replaces most of this.

topConcepts.note: Crucial for understanding how Java runs; Deep.
